border-top-width | The thickness of the top border: a length such as `4px`, or `thin`, `medium` or `thick`. It has no effect while the style is `none`. [length / thin, medium, thick] | `box: padding = 12 border = "1px solid #0f766e" border top width = 8 content = "top 8px" end` |

| `border top style`
سبک کادر بالا
border-top-style | The line style of the top border: `none`, `hidden`, `dotted`, `dashed`, `solid`, `double`, `groove`, `ridge`, `inset` or `outset`. With no style, nothing is drawn. [none, hidden, dotted, dashed, solid, double, ...] | `box: padding = 12 border = "6px solid #0f766e" border top style = dashed content = "top dashed" end` |

| `border top color`
رنگ کادر بالا
border-top-color | The color of the top border only. It takes any color. Without it the border uses the text `color` of the element. [color] | `box: padding = 12 border = "4px solid #cbd5e1" border top color = "#db2777" content = "top color" end` |

### Block sides

| Property | What it does and what it accepts | Example |

کادر بلوکی

سبک کادر بلوکی آغاز

[none, hidden, dotted, dashed, solid, double, ...] | `box: padding = 12 border = "6px solid #7c3aed" border block start style = dashed content = "block-start dashed" end` |

### Corners

| Property | What it does and what it accepts | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `border radius`
گردی کادر
border-radius | Rounds the corners. One value rounds all four; two values are top left with bottom right, then top right with bottom left; four go clockwise from the top left. A `/` gives separate horizontal and vertical radii for oval corners, and `50%` on a square makes a circle. [length / percentage; up to 4 values] | `box: width = 120 height = 70 padding = 8 background = "#bae6fd" border radius = "24px 4px" content = "24px 4px" end` |

| `border top left radius`
گردی کادر بالا چپ
border-top-left-radius | Rounds only the top left corner. One value makes it circular; two values (`40px 20px`) make an oval with a horizontal and then a vertical radius. [length / percentage; up to 2 values] | `box: width = 120 height = 70 padding = 8 background = "#bae6fd" border top left radius = "40px 20px" content = "top left 40px 20px" end` |

| `border top right radius`
گردی کادر بالا راست
border-top-right-radius | Rounds only the top right corner. One value makes it circular; two values (`40px 20px`) make an oval with a horizontal and then a vertical radius. [length / percentage; up to 2 values] | `box: width = 120 height = 70 padding = 8 background = "#bae6fd" border top right radius = 30 content = "top right 30" end` |

| `border bottom left radius`
گردی کادر پایین چپ
border-bottom-left-radius | Rounds only the bottom left corner. One value makes it circular; two values (`40px 20px`) make an oval with a horizontal and then a vertical radius. [length / percentage; up to 2 values] | `box: width = 120 height = 70 padding = 8 background = "#bae6fd" border bottom left radius = "50%" content = "bottom left 50%" end` |

| `border bottom right radius`
گردی کادر پایین راست
border-bottom-right-radius | Rounds only the bottom right corner. One value makes it circular; two values (`40px 20px`) make an oval with a horizontal and then a vertical radius. [length / percentage; up to 2 values] | `box: width = 120 height = 70 padding = 8 background = "#bae6fd" border bottom right radius = "60px 10px" content = "bottom right 60px 10px" end` |

| `border start start radius`
گردی کادر آغاز آغاز
border-start-start-radius | Rounds the corner at the start of the block side at the start of the inline side (top left in English, top right in Persian). It follows the writing direction, like the other logical properties. One or two values, as for the physical corners. [length / percentage; up to 2 values] | `box: width = 120 height = 70 padding = 8 background = "#bae6fd" border start start radius = 28 content = "start-start" end` |

| `border start end radius`
گردی کادر آغاز انتها
border-start-end-radius | Rounds the corner at the block start with the inline end (top right in English, top left in Persian). It follows the writing direction, like the other logical properties. One or two values, as for the physical corners. [length / percentage; up to 2 values] | `box: width = 120 height = 70 padding = 8 background = "#bae6fd" border start end radius = "36px 12px" content = "start-end" end` |

| `border end start radius`
گردی کادر انتها آغاز
border-end-start-radius | Rounds the corner at the block end with the inline start (bottom left in English, bottom right in Persian). It follows the writing direction, like the other logical properties. One or two values, as for the physical corners. [length / percentage; up to 2 values] | `box: width = 120 height = 70 padding = 8 background = "#bae6fd" border end start radius = "50%" content = "end-start" end` |

| `border end end radius`
گردی کادر انتها انتها
border-end-end-radius | Rounds the corner at the block end with the inline end (bottom right in English, bottom left in Persian). It follows the writing direction, like the other logical properties. One or two values, as for the physical corners. [length / percentage; up to 2 values] | `box: width = 120 height = 70 padding = 8 background = "#bae6fd" border end end radius = 40 content = "end-end" end` |

### Border image

| Property | What it does and what it accepts | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `border image`
تصویر کادر
border-image | The shorthand for the border image: a source, then a slice, then the width and outset after `/`, then the repeat, for example `linear-gradient(#f59e0b, #db2777) 1 / 8px`. The border itself must have a width, and a transparent color lets the image show. [CSS-wide keywords only] | `box: padding = 12 border = "14px solid transparent" border image = "linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #db2777) 1" content = "gradient frame" end` |

| `border image source`
منبع تصویر کادر
border-image-source | The image drawn as the border: a `url(...)` (a data URL works too), a gradient, or `none`. [image] | `box: padding = 12 border = "14px solid transparent" border image source = "linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #6366f1)" border image slice = 1 content = "image source" end` |

| `border image slice`
برش تصویر کادر
border-image-slice | Where the image is cut into nine parts: up to four numbers or percentages measured from the top, right, bottom and left edges of the image. The corners are used as they are and the edges are repeated or stretched. The word `fill` keeps the middle part too. [number / percentage; up to 5 values] | `box: padding = 12 border = "14px solid transparent" border image source = "repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #0f766e 0 6px, #99f6e4 6px 12px)" border image slice = 2 content = "slice 2" end` |

| `border image width`
ضخامت تصویر کادر
border-image-width | The size of the area the image is drawn into, one to four values: a length, a percentage of the box, or a plain number that multiplies the border width. The default is `1`. [length / percentage / number; up to 4 values] | `box: padding = 12 border = "14px solid transparent" border image source = "linear-gradient(#f43f5e, #f59e0b)" border image slice = 1 border image width = 2 content = "twice the border width" end` |

| `border image outset`
بیرون‌زدگی تصویر کادر
border-image-outset | How far the image is pushed outward past the border box, one to four values as a length or a plain number of border widths. It does not take any room in the layout. [length / number; up to 4 values] | `box: margin = 16 padding = 12 border = "14px solid transparent" border image source = "linear-gradient(135deg, #16a34a, #0891b2)" border image slice = 1 border image outset = 8 content = "pushed out 8px" end` |

| `border image repeat`
تکرار تصویر کادر
border-image-repeat | How the edge pieces fill their sides, one value for both directions or two (horizontal, vertical): `stretch` (the default), `repeat`, `round` (repeat, resized to fit a whole number of times) and `space` (repeat with gaps). [up to 2 values] | `box: padding = 12 border = "14px solid transparent" border image source = "repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #7c3aed 0 10px, #ddd6fe 10px 20px)" border image slice = 1 border image repeat = round content = "round" end` |

### Outline

| Property | What it does and what it accepts | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `outline`
دورخط
outline | Draws a line around the outside of the element, in the same `width style color` form as `border`. It takes no room in the layout and can follow rounded corners in current browsers. Focus rings are outlines. [CSS-wide keywords only] | `box: padding = 12 outline = "3px solid #2563eb" content = "outline" end` |

| `outline width`
ضخامت دورخط
outline-width | The thickness of the outline: a length, or `thin`, `medium` or `thick`. It has no effect while the style is `none`. [length / thin, medium, thick] | `box: padding = 12 outline style = solid outline color = "#ea580c" outline width = 6 content = "6px outline" end` |

| `outline style`
سبک دورخط
outline-style | The line style of the outline: the same values as border styles, and also `auto`, which asks the browser for its own native focus ring. [auto, none, hidden, dotted, dashed, solid, ...] | `box: padding = 12 outline style = dotted outline width = 3 outline color = "#7c3aed" content = "dotted outline" end` |

| `outline color`
رنگ دورخط
outline-color | The color of the outline. It takes any color. Keep a focus outline easy to see against both the element and the page behind it. [color] | `box: padding = 12 outline style = solid outline width = 3 outline color = "#db2777" content = "pink outline" end` |

| `outline offset`
فاصله دورخط
outline-offset | The gap between the outline and the edge of the border box, as a length. A positive value moves the outline away, a negative one pulls it inside. The default is `0`. [length] | `box: padding = 12 margin = 10 outline = "2px dashed #0f766e" outline offset = 8 content = "8px away" end` |

### Shadow, breaks and corner shapes

| Property | What it does and what it accepts | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `box decoration break`
شکستن تزیین جعبه
box-decoration-break | What happens to the padding, border and background of an element that breaks across lines or columns. `slice` (the default) cuts one piece into parts and `clone` gives every part its own full decoration. [slice, clone] | `paragraph: width = 180 content = "A " span: box decoration break = clone background = "#fde68a" padding = "0 8px" border radius = 6 content = "highlight that wraps over two lines" end end` |

| `box shadow`
سایه کادر
box-shadow | Draws one or more shadows around the box. Each shadow is `x y blur spread color`: the horizontal and vertical offset, how soft the edge is, how much larger or smaller it is, and its color. The word `inset` draws it inside. Separate several shadows with commas; the first is on top. [comma list] | `box: padding = 16 border radius = 10 box shadow = "0 6px 16px rgb(0 0 0 / 20%), inset 0 0 0 1px #cbd5e1" content = "two shadows" end` |

| `corner shape`
شکل گوشه
corner-shape | Changes the shape of the corners that `border radius` rounds, one to four values: `round` (the default), `squircle`, `bevel`, `scoop`, `notch`, `square` or `superellipse()`. It is new and works only in Chromium browsers for now; elsewhere the corners stay round. [up to 4 of round, scoop, bevel, notch, square, squircle, superellipse()] | `box: padding = 16 border radius = 24 corner shape = "squircle" background = "#0ea5e9" color = "white" content = "squircle" end` |

| `corner top left shape`
شکل گوشه بالا چپ
corner-top-left-shape | The shape of the top left corner only: `round`, `squircle`, `bevel`, `scoop`, `notch`, `square` or `superellipse()`. It needs a `border radius` to show, and only Chromium browsers draw it for now. [a corner shape keyword or superellipse()] | `box: padding = 16 border radius = 28 corner top left shape = scoop background = "#ea580c" color = "white" content = "top left: scoop" end` |

| `corner top right shape`
شکل گوشه بالا راست
corner-top-right-shape | The shape of the top right corner only: `round`, `squircle`, `bevel`, `scoop`, `notch`, `square` or `superellipse()`. It needs a `border radius` to show, and only Chromium browsers draw it for now. [a corner shape keyword or superellipse()] | `box: padding = 16 border radius = 28 corner top right shape = bevel background = "#16a34a" color = "white" content = "top right: bevel" end` |

| `corner bottom left shape`
شکل گوشه پایین چپ
corner-bottom-left-shape | The shape of the bottom left corner only: `round`, `squircle`, `bevel`, `scoop`, `notch`, `square` or `superellipse()`. It needs a `border radius` to show, and only Chromium browsers draw it for now. [a corner shape keyword or superellipse()] | `box: padding = 16 border radius = 28 corner bottom left shape = notch background = "#7c3aed" color = "white" content = "bottom left: notch" end` |

| `corner bottom right shape`
شکل گوشه پایین راست
corner-bottom-right-shape | The shape of the bottom right corner only: `round`, `squircle`, `bevel`, `scoop`, `notch`, `square` or `superellipse()`. It needs a `border radius` to show, and only Chromium browsers draw it for now. [a corner shape keyword or superellipse()] | `box: padding = 16 border radius = 28 corner bottom right shape = squircle background = "#db2777" color = "white" content = "bottom right: squircle" end` |

## Try it yourself

- Make a notification box with a thick `border inline start` in red, then put it inside a box with `dir = "rtl"` and check that the stripe moves to the right by itself.

- Build a button with a pill shape, a `box shadow` that gets smaller on `active`, and a focus ring of a different color.

- Make a gradient border with `border image` and a slice of 1, and try to round its corners. What happens, and what can you use instead?

- Add a fourth slider to the shadow lab that changes the spread, and a checkbox that adds the word `inset`.
